summary.text: Bob Mahacek is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 95, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Meredith Sumenek is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Bob Mahacek advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 95.
Ballotpedia also lists him as the Republican candidate in District 92 in 2022, when incumbent Michael Burton defeated him in the general election.
